learn-the-conversation-map.label: Learn the Conversation Map
learn-the-conversation-map.summary: Bring together greetings, names, identity, language, and residence in a short first meeting.

learn-the-conversation-map-choice.title: Choose the first question
learn-the-conversation-map-choice.prompt: After Bonjou, which question naturally checks how the other person is?
learn-the-conversation-map-choice.hint: Choose the greeting follow-up from Module 2.

help.concept: A first meeting can begin with a greeting followed by a simple check-in.
help.hint_1: Reuse a complete pattern you practiced earlier in this course.
help.hint_2: Read or listen to the whole exchange before answering.

learn-the-conversation-map-fill.title: Complete the name answer
learn-the-conversation-map-fill.prompt: Choose the verb that completes the short name introduction.
learn-the-conversation-map-fill.hint: Use the name pattern from Module 3.

help.concept: The blank completes the familiar pattern for giving a name.
help.hint_1: Reuse a complete pattern you practiced earlier in this course.

learn-the-conversation-map-listen.title: Hear a first meeting
learn-the-conversation-map-listen.prompt: Listen, then build the answer you hear.
learn-the-conversation-map-listen.hint: Listen for a positive response followed by the language sentence.

help.concept: Build the complete answer in spoken order.

meet-someone.title: Start with what you already know
meet-someone.bodyMarkdown:
A first conversation can stay simple:

**A:** Bonjou! Kijan ou ye?

**B:** Mwen byen, mèsi. E ou menm?

**A:** Mwen byen tou. Kijan ou rele?

**B:** M rele Ana.

Every line comes from earlier modules.

identity-place.title: Language and residence
identity-place.bodyMarkdown:
Continue with information you can already express:

**A:** Èske ou pale kreyòl?

**B:** Wi, mwen pale kreyòl.

**A:** Ki kote ou rete?

**B:** Mwen rete Chicago.

Short complete answers are enough.

keep-simple.title: Simple Kreyòl is useful Kreyòl
keep-simple.bodyMarkdown: A successful beginner conversation does not need advanced grammar. Use short patterns you control well: greet, ask one question, listen, answer, and ask a natural follow-up.
